segmentler.metin: The Titanic sank on her maiden voyage.
It took only an iceberg scraping along the starboard side.
So how could an iceberg scraping along the starboard side do this?
The answer is hull breaches across more watertight compartments than the design could survive — and it is why SOLAS rules made lifeboats for everyone aboard mandatory.
